video_title: Adventure Awaits: The Perfect Orange Tee for Every Journey
video_hook: Watch this orange tee transform from closet basic to adventure essential in 3 seconds
target_audience: Young adults aged 18-35 who love outdoor activities, casual fashion, and adventure lifestyle
video_objective: Showcase the t-shirt's versatility, quality, and adventure-ready style to drive purchase decisions

scenes.scene_purpose: Grab attention immediately and establish the adventure theme
scenes.setting: Clean white studio background with dramatic lighting

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the circular mountain graphic on the left chest of the orange t-shirt, with dramatic side lighting creating shadows that emphasize the texture and detail of the embroidered design
frames.lighting: dramatic side lighting with deep shadows
frames.background_details: Pure white seamless background with gradient shadows

frames.visual_prompt: Quick zoom out revealing the full orange t-shirt hanging on an invisible mannequin, the vibrant orange color popping against the white background with soft studio lighting
frames.background_details: Minimalist white studio with subtle gradient

frames.visual_prompt: Smooth tracking shot as a young adventurous person's hands grab the t-shirt from off-camera, the fabric flowing naturally with the movement
frames.background_details: White background transitioning to outdoor setting

scenes.scene_purpose: Demonstrate the t-shirt in various adventure and lifestyle contexts
scenes.setting: Multiple outdoor locations - hiking trail, coffee shop, city street

frames.visual_prompt: Medium shot of an attractive young person wearing the orange t-shirt while hiking, the mountain graphic perfectly matching the real mountains in the blurred background, golden hour lighting
frames.background_details: Mountain landscape with hiking trail, beautifully blurred

frames.visual_prompt: Over-shoulder shot of the same person looking at a scenic mountain vista, the orange t-shirt creating a beautiful contrast against the natural landscape
frames.background_details: Expansive mountain vista with clear blue sky

frames.visual_prompt: Quick pan shot of the person walking through a trendy coffee shop, the orange t-shirt standing out stylishly among the urban setting, other patrons slightly blurred
frames.background_details: Modern coffee shop interior with exposed brick and plants

scenes.scene_purpose: Highlight the quality, fit, and design details of the t-shirt
scenes.setting: Clean studio environment with dynamic lighting

frames.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the fabric texture of the orange t-shirt, showing the soft cotton weave and high-quality construction with macro-lens detail
frames.lighting: soft directional lighting to show texture
frames.background_details: Neutral gray background with subtle texture

frames.visual_prompt: Close-up of the crew neckline showing the perfect fit and construction quality, with hands gently adjusting the collar to demonstrate comfort
Wide shot of model wearing the orange t-shirt in perfect fit, arms slightly raised to show the comfortable cut and how it moves with the body

scenes.scene_title: Call to Action and Brand Connection
scenes.scene_purpose: Create urgency and drive purchase decision
scenes.setting: Dynamic studio with multiple t-shirts and lifestyle elements

frames.visual_prompt: Overhead shot of multiple orange t-shirts laid out artistically with outdoor adventure gear like hiking boots, compass, and map, creating a lifestyle flat lay
frames.background_details: Wooden surface with adventure accessories arranged aesthetically

frames.visual_prompt: Quick zoom in on the mountain graphic logo, with text overlay appearing 'Your Adventure Starts Here' in bold modern typography
frames.background_details: Dark background to make the graphic pop

frames.visual_prompt: Final wide shot of the model wearing the orange t-shirt with arms crossed confidently, slight smile, with 'Shop Now' text overlay and brand logo appearing
frames.background_details: Clean gradient background from white to light orange
